newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Russia mull special border trade zone.
newsitem.headline: China, Russia mull special border trade zone.

text.p: China and Russia are working on a plan to boost cross-border trade by setting up a special zone that would allow free movement for traders, the semi-official China News Service said on Tuesday.
The zone would be created near the northeastern Chinese city of Suifenhe, the news agency said.
Trade between China and Russia through Suifenhe amounted to 2.1 billion yuan ($253.0 million) between January and August despite tight border controls, the agency said.
It said many Russian traders visit the Chinese side of the border but it was difficult for Chinese citizens to leave the country.
It gave no further details but the two nations are eager to boost trade ties.
Chinese Premier Li Peng will leave for Moscow on Thursday on a visit largely aimed at spurring economic links between the two countries.
